notes: Maroon fascia sign hung under the balcony of a three-storey wooden building on Fort Street, Basseterre (camera 17.2955, -62.7238), seen at a steep angle. Left panel is an interlocked monogram (read as O/A/E/G) over 'ESQUIRE'; the monogram reading is uncertain. Distractors: pink 'LIME' street banner, an event banner, 'Fort Street Ice cream Parlour' and 'Daily Basics' shop signs. Pedestrians and a van with a plate are incidental. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

DR. THE HON. DENZIL LLEWELLYN DOUGLAS.
THIS COMPLEX STANDS ON THE SITE OF
THE OLD COURT HOUSE AND PUBLIC LIBRARY
AND WAS FUNDED BY THE GOVERNMENT
OF ST. KITTS AND NEVIS AND US/AID.

notes: Engraved white-marble dedication plaque set in a wall recess, Basseterre (no camera location); frontal and sharp. Some letters have worn fill (the P in COMPLEX and OPENED look like 'F'/'C'), but the words are clear. The building name is in the first line; the rest is commemorative text.
